name: Bed Autocreation
script:
created = [] updated = [] for row in (doc.bed_numbers or []): exists = frappe.db.exists({ "doctype": "Bed", "greenhouse": doc.greenhouse, "bed": row.bed_no }) if exists: bed = frappe.get_doc("Bed", { "greenhouse": doc.greenhouse, "bed": row.bed_no }) bed.farm = row.farm or doc.farm bed.variety = row.variety_grown or doc.variety bed.bed_length = row.bed_length bed.bed_width = row.bed_width bed.bed_area = row.bed_area bed.total_variety_area = doc.total_beds_area bed.save(ignore_permissions=True) updated.append( f"Bed No {row.bed_no} updated " f"(Variety: {row.variety_grown or doc.variety}, " f"Area: {row.bed_area} m²)" ) else: bed = frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "Bed", "greenhouse": doc.greenhouse, "farm": row.farm or doc.farm, "variety": row.variety_grown or doc.variety, "bed_length": row.bed_length, "bed_width": row.bed_width, "bed_area": row.bed_area, "bed": row.bed_no, "total_variety_area": doc.total_beds_area }) bed.insert(ignore_permissions=True) created.append( f"Bed No {row.bed_no} created " f"(Variety: {row.variety_grown or doc.variety}, " f"Area: {row.bed_area} m²)" ) if created: frappe.msgprint("
".join(created), title="New Bed(s) Created", indicator="green") if updated: frappe.msgprint("
".join(updated), title="Existing Bed(s) Updated", indicator="blue") if not created and not updated: frappe.msgprint("No Beds were created or updated.", indicator="orange")

name: Bed Sampling Expected Harvest Calculator
script:
# --- Read base values --- sample_date = doc.get("date") variety = doc.get("variety") total_sampled_area = frappe.utils.flt(doc.get("total_sampled_area") or 0) area_covered_by_variety = frappe.utils.flt(doc.get("area_covered_by_variety") or 0) # --- Totals by stage --- rice_total = 0.0 ball_total = 0.0 colour_break_total = 0.0 full_colour_break_total = 0.0 for row in (doc.get("growth_stages") or []): rice_total = rice_total + frappe.utils.flt(row.get("rice_stage") or 0) ball_total = ball_total + frappe.utils.flt(row.get("ball_stage") or 0) colour_break_total = colour_break_total + frappe.utils.flt(row.get("colour_break_stage") or 0) full_colour_break_total = full_colour_break_total + frappe.utils.flt(row.get("full_colour_break_stage") or 0) total_stems = rice_total + ball_total + colour_break_total + full_colour_break_total # --- Forecast yield calculations --- if total_sampled_area > 0 and area_covered_by_variety > 0: this_week_yield = (full_colour_break_total * area_covered_by_variety) / total_sampled_area yield_from_colour_break = (colour_break_total * area_covered_by_variety) / total_sampled_area yield_from_ball = (ball_total * area_covered_by_variety) / total_sampled_area yield_from_rice = (rice_total * area_covered_by_variety) / total_sampled_area else: this_week_yield = 0 yield_from_colour_break = 0 yield_from_ball = 0 yield_from_rice = 0 # --- Store forecast yield --- doc.db_set("forecast_yield", this_week_yield) # --- Days-to-harvest per stage from Variety Growth Stages --- growth_stage_rows = frappe.get_all( "Growth Stage Configuration", filters={"parent": variety}, fields=["growth_stage", "days_to_harvest"] ) # Default values days_colour_break = 7 days_ball = 18 days_rice = 30 for g in growth_stage_rows: stage = (g.get("growth_stage") or "").strip().lower() days = g.get("days_to_harvest") or 0 if "colour" in stage and "break" in stage: days_colour_break = days elif "ball" in stage: days_ball = days elif "rice" in stage: days_rice = days # --- Compute harvest dates --- sample_date_obj = frappe.utils.getdate(sample_date) harvest_date_colour_break = frappe.utils.add_days(sample_date_obj, days_colour_break) harvest_date_ball = frappe.utils.add_days(sample_date_obj, days_ball) harvest_date_rice = frappe.utils.add_days(sample_date_obj, days_rice) # Compute ISO week numbers safely (integer approximation) current_week = sample_date_obj.isocalendar()[1] harvest_week_colour_break = current_week + (days_colour_break // 7) harvest_week_ball = current_week + (days_ball // 7) harvest_week_rice = current_week + (days_rice // 7) # --- Precompute rounded values --- rw = round(rice_total, 0) bw = round(ball_total, 0) cbw = round(colour_break_total, 0) fcbw = round(full_colour_break_total, 0) ty0 = round(this_week_yield, 0) ty2 = round(this_week_yield, 2) ycb = round(yield_from_colour_break, 0) yb = round(yield_from_ball, 0) yr = round(yield_from_rice, 0) ts = round(total_stems, 0) # --- Build message safely --- lines = [] lines.append("Your expected harvest (Week " + str(current_week) + "): " + str(ty0) + "

") lines.append("Upcoming harvest forecast by stage
") lines.append("• From Colour Break: " + str(ycb) + " (expected harvest Week " + str(harvest_week_colour_break) + ")
") lines.append("• From Ball Stage: " + str(yb) + " (expected harvest Week " + str(harvest_week_ball) + ")
") lines.append("• From Rice Stage: " + str(yr) + " (expected harvest Week " + str(harvest_week_rice) + ")

") lines.append("Total stems counted (by stage)
") lines.append("• Rice stage: " + str(rw) + "
") lines.append("• Ball stage: " + str(bw) + "
") lines.append("• Colour Break stage: " + str(cbw) + "
") lines.append("• Full Colour Break stage: " + str(fcbw) + "

") lines.append("Summary
") lines.append("• Total stems counted (sum): " + str(ts) + "
") lines.append("• Total sampled area: " + str(total_sampled_area) + "
") lines.append("• Area covered by variety: " + str(area_covered_by_variety) + "
") lines.append("• Expected variety yield (Full Colour Break × Area covered by variety ÷ Total Sampled Area): " + str(ty2)) message = "".join(lines) frappe.msgprint(message, title="Bed Sampling Forecast", indicator="blue")
